name: br-indirect-tax
description: Use this Guide to classify and compute Brazilian ICMS, ISS and IPI for an individual professional, sole business or company carrying out a domestic sale, service, industrial operation or import in calendar 2026. It explains the tax base, responsible party, invoice evidence, input credits, service location, interstate rate route, final-consumer DIFAL and interaction with Simples Nacional. It covers ordinary transactions and identifies the additional state, municipal or product evidence needed for a calculation. Trigger phrases include ICMS, ISS, IPI, nota fiscal, NFS-e, interstate sale, service withholding and Brazilian indirect tax. Load brazil-vat for federal PIS/Cofins and the CBS/IBS transition, and br-simples-nacional for the unified small-business computation.
